title: Vendor knowledge-base entry
description: One third-party vendor's curated data. See CONTRIBUTING.md before editing or adding a file here — every claim needs to be either backed by an evidence URL or honestly marked unknown. Validated by scripts/validate-kb.ts (npm run kb:check).

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Must equal the filename (vendors/<id>.json). Never renamed once published — other vendors' alternatives[] reference it.

aliases.description: Other detection strings (npm package names, mainly) this same vendor is also known by, beyond packages.npm.

packages.description: The primary package name per ecosystem this vendor is imported/required under. null where not yet mapped for that ecosystem — never guess a package name that hasn't actually been checked.

envPrefixes.description: Env var names (today: exact names, each trivially a valid prefix of itself) that identify this vendor when found in a repo's env files.

hosts.description: Known global API hostnames for scripts/verify-substrates.ts's DNS/IP-range check. Empty when the vendor's real endpoint is a per-tenant subdomain with no single global host to check — never a guessed placeholder.

confidence.description: verified = backed by an official/first-party source in evidence[]. reported = someone claimed it (docs, a blog post, a prior curator) but it isn't independently confirmed, or there is a live finding worth a second look. unknown = no real source at all.

evidence.description: Required (at least one entry) when confidence is verified or reported. Must be empty when confidence is unknown — never a placeholder entry.

oneOf.description: sourceUrl/retrievedAt are null where the SLA number is an unsourced curator estimate, same honesty rule as substrate — never a fabricated citation.

alternatives.description: Vendor ids (not names) of same-category substitutes. Every id here must exist as vendors/<id>.json — checked by scripts/validate-kb.ts, not by this schema alone.
